# Vamp

> Open-source, local-first remote desktop and terminal suite for macOS,
> iPhone, iPad, Safari, and Linux. Connections use a trusted LAN or private
> Tailscale network, and every new device requires visible host approval.

Website: https://thevamp.app/
Source: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/macpair
Releases: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/macpair/releases
License: Apache-2.0
Minimum macOS: 13.0
Minimum iOS/iPadOS: 18.0

## Kits

- Remote desktop: Vamp Host + Vamp Control over signed WebRTC.
- Mac terminal: Vamp Terminal Host + Vamp Terminal or Safari. Always-on
  terminal. Do not also run Vamp Host on the same Mac.
- Linux shell: Vamp Linux Host + a browser. WebSocket on loopback 9475.
  Vamp Control and Vamp Terminal cannot attach.

Safari control is built into the macOS hosts. There is no Safari download.

## When to use Vamp

Use Vamp when a person wants to reach a machine they own over a trusted LAN or
private Tailscale network without a hosted relay or product account. Choose
Vamp Host when the job needs the Mac display, pointer, keyboard, clipboard,
files, audio, or an optional terminal. Choose Vamp Terminal Host when the job
needs terminal and Safari control only. Choose Vamp Linux Host for a
dependency-free Python terminal host that is opened from a browser.

Do not use Vamp to access an unknown machine, bypass host consent, expose ports
to the public internet, or approve a peer whose fingerprint was not verified
independently. Transport disconnects detach clients; they do not end persistent
terminal sessions.

## How an agent should call Vamp

1. Run `vamp ensure`, then inspect `vamp status --json`.
2. If pairing is pending, run `vamp pending --json` and show the user the exact
   device name and fingerprint.
3. Require the user to confirm the independently verified fingerprint exactly.
4. Only then run `vamp approve-pairing --fingerprint <verified-hex>`.
5. Use `vamp terminal list`, `vamp terminal start --session <name>`, or
   `vamp terminal attach <name>` for persistent terminal work.
6. Use `vamp terminal agent <name> --session <name>` only when the user asks.
   Launchers: opencode, pi, commandcode, chatgpt, claude, kimi, qwen, codex,
   aider, grok. Vamp Control has no agent launchers.

Never approve a request merely because it exists. Never bypass Screen Recording
or Accessibility consent. Never publish host, signaling, data, or browser ports
to the public internet.

## Products

- Vamp Host: full macOS host for display, input, clipboard, files, audio, and an opt-in terminal.
- Vamp Terminal Host: always-on terminal and Safari-control-only macOS host.
- Vamp Control: remote-control client for macOS, iPhone, and iPad. Terminal Mode is an overlay.
- Vamp Terminal: eight-tab terminal client for iPhone and iPad, with ten agent launchers.
- Vamp Linux Host: dependency-free Python browser host. Not a WebRTC peer.
